documents: lexicalControls in ../lexical_test.go, original order, exact UTF-8 bytes

lexical.engine_config: default engine configuration; record actual analyzer/schema versions for each engine
lexical.scope_control: repeat scope key with personal kind; group request must exclude personal revisions
lexical.large_corpus: for zero-based i use lexicalControls[i%9].text; ID/item/memory_key=bench-%05d formatted i; scope_change_seq=i+1; other defaults unchanged

hybrid_retrieval_only.provider: deterministic fake; no network or TEI latency
hybrid_retrieval_only.query_vectors: four float32 unit vectors e0,e1,e2,e3; use identical bytes in both engines
hybrid_retrieval_only.chunk_vectors: for zero-based chunk i use float32 unit vector e(i%768)
hybrid_retrieval_only.chunk_assignment: first 128 chunks belong to bench-00000 with ordinals 0..127; chunks i>=128 belong to bench-%05d formatted i-127, ordinal 0; exact lexical text/defaults as above
hybrid_retrieval_only.ranking_oracle: cosine maximum across every eligible chunk and all four query vectors per revision before top-k; ties by revision ID
hybrid_retrieval_only.model_identity: derive from the same existing model-space/preparation API in each checkout; record fingerprint before measurement

measurement.task: boyan-48w.19; this profile defines input, not measured performance
measurement.warm: ingest/build once, one untimed query pass, then timed retrieval without writes
measurement.cold: close/reopen between repetitions; report OS page-cache state as uncontrolled unless explicitly controlled
measurement.end_to_end_provider: separate pinned TEI measurement; do not mix provider latency into retrieval-only comparison
measurement.comparability: same machine, Go version, GOMAXPROCS, corpus bytes/hash, time, filters, vectors and request limits; retain each engine's pinned dependency graph and record differences
